definitions.explanation: A legal official who investigates crimes and brings criminal charges on behalf of the state. In Japan, prosecutors belong to the {検察庁|けんさつちょう} (Public Prosecutors Office).

examples.japanese: {検事|けんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}した→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{検事|けんじ}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧20⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: He has been working as a prosecutor for 20 years.

examples.japanese: {検事|けんじ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{被告|ひこく}→被告：11080_hikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{懲役|ちょうえき}→懲役：11087_choueki⟧10⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The prosecutor demanded a 10-year prison sentence for the defendant.

notes:
Refers to a public official who prosecutes criminal cases. In Japan, prosecutors ({検事|けんじ}) work under the {検察庁|けんさつちょう} (Public Prosecutors Office) and have significant authority, including the power to investigate crimes independently.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {検事|けんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}する→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧: the prosecutor indicts
- {検事|けんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{求刑|きゅうけい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the prosecutor demands a sentence
- {検事|けんじ}{総長|そうちょう}: the Prosecutor General
- {検事正|けんじせい}: the Chief Prosecutor

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{検察官|けんさつかん}→検察官：09664_kensatsukan⟧: prosecutor — the formal/official title
- {検察庁|けんさつちょう}: Public Prosecutors Office
- ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧: lawyer, attorney — defends the accused
- ⟦{裁判官|さいばんかん}→裁判官：09562_saibankan⟧: judge

USAGE:
{検事|けんじ} and ⟦{検察官|けんさつかん}→検察官：09664_kensatsukan⟧ are often used interchangeably in everyday language, but technically ⟦{検察官|けんさつかん}→検察官：09664_kensatsukan⟧ is the broader official title while {検事|けんじ} refers to a specific rank within the prosecution system.
